question:
Identify the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Accept
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accept"** means to consent **to receive or undertake something offered. (**स्वीकार करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She **accepted** the job offer with enthusiasm.
 
 
 
• **"Agree"** refers to having the **same opinion about something; to consent or to say yes.** (सहमत होना)
 
 
• **Example:** They **agreed** to meet at the cafe at 5 PM.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the appropriate meaning of 'Accept' is 'Agree'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Regret** (अफसोस): To feel sad or disappointed over something.

 
 
• **Example:** He** regretted **not attending the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Refuse** (मना करना): To indicate or show that one is not willing to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** She **refused** to answer the question.
 
 
 
• **Present** (उपस्थित): To give something to someone formally or ceremonially.
 
 
• **Example:** He **presented **the award to the winner.
 
 

52:Tbc1,

The correct answer is Option 1)</b&
